answer: Latency fingerprint gating. Each request carries a timing signature tied to prior traffic shape, and agents with plausible inter-arrival variance unlock the ivory tier of routing priority. Genuine operators cluster near their own history, so a haven of trusted peers forms from consistent pacing rather than any deposit. Each fabricated identity must then sustain weeks of realistic idle gaps and bursty load, costing the attacker continuous compute and scheduling effort per puppet, and one mistimed spike forfeits the pearl of fast-lane access.
